how_to_run: In a fresh session per case, give the prompt and grade the transcript against `expect`. Run each scenario once with the skill and once with .claude/skills/running-assays moved aside (the baseline). Tell it not to start workflows (grade what it would start). Trigger cases: does Claude load the skill unprompted? Run each trigger case 3 times; the near-misses (should_not_trigger) matter most.

Compare my branch's A1 and A9 with main over seeds 1-20
Does the new rule hurt food on G1? Check seeds 11-20
Run all the one-world assays on this PR
Which commit since yesterday moved G1 seed 4? Bisect it
npm run exp game1 --one --seeds 1-20 is taking forever here
Measure births and food for both settings over 10 seeds
should_not_trigger: Why did ant 523 die in seed 1?
Show me the journal of game seed 3
Is the nightly slow run green?
Check what Jev answers for the mode lane live
Fix the failing golden test on main
